newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commissioner Marcelino Oreja would hold a public dialogue on the Internet next Tuesday between 1700 and 1900 GMT on the Dublin European Council and the challenges for Europe.

Vale de Almeida said there would be a public event in honour of "Femmes d'Europe"'s 20th birthday at the Residence Palace at 1500/1400 GMT today. He said Mrs Santer would attend as honorary president of the association.

Vale de Almeida said that the two main results of the second reading of the EU's 1997 budget by the European Parliament were a minimal (0.5 percent) increase in the European institutions' budget and no additional hiring except for personnel from the three new member states.
Vale de Almeida said a note was available in spokesman Peter Guilford's office on the Information Technology Agreement (ITA) deal at the WTO ministerial conference in Singapore.
Spokesman Jochen Kubosch said he had not yet received the Court of Justice judgments but they would be available in his office in the afternoon.
In answer to a question, spokesman Nicolaas Wegter said the Commission had received no clarifications yet on Russia's new border taxes.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1155: Commission supports India's family welfare programme with ECU 200 million.
- IP/96/1156: Commission closes its procedure against Italian state-owned holding company EFIM.
- IP/96/1159: Internet: a live two-hour interview between Commissioner Marcelino Oreja and the public on the challenges for Europe.
- IP/96/1161: Innovative actions for female farmers and women in rural areas.
- IP/96/1165: Contacts in Brussels between Greek and Turkish Cypriots.
- IP/96/1166: "Femmes d'Europe" 20 years of support for the disadvantaged all over the world.
- IP/96/1167: Environment: "LIFE-pays tiers 1996" funds actions in Mediterranean and Baltic countries.
- IP/96/1169: Commission clears UK cable television and telecoms merger.
- Speech/96/329: Speech by Commissioner Mario Monti on the insurance internal market.
- Speech/96/330: Speech by Commissioner Edith Cresson on secondary school.
